title: A Very Big Jumper

pre.en: What did the shop's reply offer Chen?
pre.zh: 店家的回信给了小陈什么？

intro: 小陈给网店客服打了一通投诉电话——没人接，他对着语音信箱留了两分钟言，Tom 在旁边听着，最后手机上收到了店家的回复。投诉要礼貌、讲事实、说清想要什么。读的时候留意比较级前面的程度词：a little looser、slightly greener 往轻里说，far bigger、way warmer、nowhere near 往重里说。

sentences.en: Hi, my name's Chen, and I'm calling to make a complaint about order 48213.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫小陈，打电话是想投诉一下 48213 号订单。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I ordered a grey jumper in size M for £45.
sentences.zh: 我订了一件 M 码的灰色毛衣，45 英镑。

sentences.en: Your website says "slightly oversized".
sentences.zh: 你们网站上写的是「略微宽松」。

sentences.en: Well, I wanted something a little looser than my other jumpers — not a tent.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想要的是比我其他毛衣稍微宽松一点的，不是一顶帐篷。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it's far bigger than that, and nowhere near an M.
sentences.zh: 可惜它比这大得多，根本不是 M 码。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: My flatmate and I tried it on together, and we could both fit inside it at once.
sentences.zh: 我和室友一起试穿，俩人能同时钻进去。

sentences.en: He said it was way warmer than his blanket.
sentences.zh: 他说这比他的毯子暖和多了。

sentences.en: The colour's also slightly greener than in your photos.
sentences.zh: 颜色也比你们照片上的偏绿一点。

sentences.en: So I'm afraid it's not as described.
sentences.zh: 所以恐怕这件毛衣跟描述的不符。

sentences.en: To be fair, the parcel arrived in one piece, and the wool feels lovely.
sentences.zh: 说句公道话，包裹送到时完好无损，羊毛摸着也挺舒服。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: And as far as I know, I chose the right size — I checked your size guide twice.
sentences.zh: 而且据我所知，我选的尺码没错，你们的尺码表我看了两遍。

sentences.en: Normally, I stick to shops where I can try things on first.
sentences.zh: 我平时只在能先试穿的店里买衣服。

sentences.en: My flatmate suggested wearing it for a week to break it in.
sentences.zh: 室友建议我先穿一个星期，把它穿服帖了。

sentences.en: But the longer I wear it, the bigger it seems to get.
sentences.zh: 可我越穿，它好像越大。

sentences.en: So I'd like to send it back.
sentences.zh: 所以我想把它退回去。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Can I get a refund?
sentences.zh: 能退款吗？

sentences.en: I'd appreciate it if someone could call me back.
sentences.zh: 麻烦哪位尽快给我回个电话。

sentences.en: Who'll deal with my return, and do I have to pay for postage?
sentences.zh: 退货由谁来处理？邮费要我自己出吗？

sentences.en: I need a jumper for a party on Saturday, so I hope you can put this right before then.
sentences.zh: 我周六要去参加聚会，得有件毛衣穿，所以希望你们能在那之前把这事处理好。

sentences.en: Please take this seriously, because a quick reply would make a difference.
sentences.zh: 请认真对待这件事，能尽快回复我就帮大忙了。

sentences.en: Thanks, bye.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，再见。

sentences.en: Did you just leave a two-minute message about a jumper?
sentences.zh: 你刚才是为了一件毛衣，留了两分钟的语音？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: It's a very big jumper.
sentences.zh: 那可是件很大的毛衣。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 也对。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Oh, your phone's buzzing.
sentences.zh: 哎，你手机在震。

sentences.en: It's them!
sentences.zh: 是他们！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Listen to this: "Thank you so much for your message!
sentences.zh: 你听听：「非常感谢您的留言！

sentences.en: We're delighted you love your new jumper.
sentences.zh: 很高兴您喜欢您的新毛衣。

sentences.en: Here's 10% off your next order.
sentences.zh: 送您下次购物九折优惠。

sentences.en: And if you have a moment, would you leave us a 5-star review?"
sentences.zh: 如果有空，能给我们一个五星好评吗？」

sentences.en: Ten per cent off?
sentences.zh: 打九折？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Get one for me, then.
sentences.zh: 那给我也买一件。

sentences.en: Actually, don't bother — I'll just share yours.
sentences.zh: 算了，不用了——我跟你合穿那件就行。

cards.note: to tell a company or person officially that you are not happy about something
cards.tip: 投诉什么用 about，向谁投诉用 to：make a complaint to the manager；动词是 complain。
cards.example: Several guests made a complaint about the noise.

cards.note: 服装网站常用词，oversized fit 是「宽松版型」。
loose 的比较级；反义是 tight（紧）。注意和 lose（丢失）区分。
搭帐篷是 put up a tent。
电热毯是 electric blanket。
the same as someone said or wrote it would be
cards.tip: 网购和二手买卖里的常用语；not as described 就是「货不对板」。
cards.example: The flat was exactly as described in the advert.

cards.note: not broken or damaged
used to say that you think something is true, but you are not completely sure
to keep doing what you planned or promised, even when it is difficult
cards.tip: stick 的过去式是 stuck；to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing。
cards.example: I'll stick to tea — coffee keeps me awake.

cards.note: to put on clothes or shoes to see if they fit or look good
to wear new shoes for short periods until they become comfortable
cards.tip: 代词放中间：break them in；多说鞋子，这里说毛衣是在打趣。
cards.example: Wear your new boots around the house to break them in.

cards.note: to return something by post because it is wrong or you do not want it
cards.tip: 代词放中间：send it back；当面拿回店里是 take sth back。
cards.example: The shoes didn't fit, so I sent them back.

cards.note: to get your money back for something you have returned
cards.tip: refund 作名词重音在前；作动词（refund the money）重音在后。
cards.example: If the train is more than an hour late, you can get a refund.

cards.note: a polite way to ask someone to do something
cards.tip: it 不能省：不说 I'd appreciate if …；if 后面常用 you could / you would。
cards.example: I'd appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.

cards.note: to take action to solve a problem or finish a task
不可数；网购常见 free postage（包邮）。
to correct a mistake or deal with a problem so that things are as they should be
cards.tip: put 的过去式、过去分词都是 put；也常说 put things right。
cards.example: The bank made a mistake, but they put it right the same day.

cards.note: to think that something is important and give it attention
cards.tip: seriously 是副词，不说 take it serious；反义是 not take sth seriously（不当回事）。
cards.example: The company takes customer complaints seriously.

cards.note: to have a good effect on someone or something
used to say that you accept what someone has said, even if you do not fully agree
手机静音时的震动就说 buzz；蜜蜂嗡嗡叫也是 buzz。
比 happy 更正式，客服和商务邮件里很常见。
